principle: Perspectival amplification through serial architectural framing multiplies depth perception by nesting concentric aperture reductions that function as optical levers, magnifying spatial recession beyond what single-point perspective mathematics alone would produce.

nodes.label: Single-point linear perspective with elevated vanishing point
nodes.description: All orthogonals converge at a point positioned at Plato's hand, creating unified spatial recession that organizes architectural and figural elements across the entire composition.
evidence: Vanishing point positioned at Plato's hand, approximately 60 percent up the vertical axis, dead center horizontally
All orthogonals converge here: floor tiles, coffered barrel vault ribs, architectural recessions
Compression ratio increases exponentially with distance from picture plane; foreground figures occupy 40 percent of picture plane for 15 meters of depth, background 10 percent for 30 meters
Stage 4 classifies as central mechanism with high confidence: removal collapses spatial coherence entirely

nodes.label: Nested architectural frames as perspectival amplifier
nodes.description: Three receding arches reduce sequentially in size (100/80/65 percent width), mechanically multiplying depth cues beyond what floor recession alone produces.
evidence: Quantified serial reduction: first arch spans full width, second roughly 80 percent of first, third roughly 65 percent of second
Stage 2 identifies the frames as mechanical multipliers of the base spatial gradient set by floor tile recession
Stage 5 describes each frame as a perspectival echo chamber: the viewer perceives three synchronized recessions confirming and amplifying each other

nodes.label: Drapery as distributed tonal system
nodes.description: Each figure's fabric folds contain the full value range, making every figure a self-sufficient tonal unit that maintains local tonal completeness independent of surrounding figures.
evidence: Each figure's drapery contains the full value range from highlight to shadow, creating local tonal completeness
Remove any single figure and the remaining composition retains tonal integrity
Stage 4 gives medium confidence: removal test requires inference about what alternative tonal infrastructure could substitute
rule_violations: Compositional necessity requires at least some structurally indispensable figures

nodes.label: Vanishing point at Plato's hand
nodes.description: The single convergence point for all orthogonals, located at Plato's hand, roughly 60 percent up the vertical axis and horizontally centered.
evidence: Structural inventory locates the vanishing point at Plato's hand, dead center horizontally
Void corridors are engineered to preserve sightlines to this point

nodes.label: Floor tile orthogonal recession
nodes.description: Receding floor tiles supply the base set of converging orthogonals that establish the primary spatial gradient of the perspectival system.
evidence: Floor tiles listed among the orthogonals converging at the vanishing point
Stage 2 names floor tile recession as the base spatial gradient that the frames then multiply

nodes.label: Three receding arches at 100/80/65 percent widths
nodes.description: The concrete architectural apertures whose serial size reduction constitutes the nested framing device: foreground arch, barrel vault, background arch.
evidence: First arch spans full fresco width, second roughly 80 percent, third roughly 65 percent
Stage 5 identifies the three concentric frames as foreground arch, barrel vault, and background arch

nodes.label: Fabric folds carrying full value range per figure
nodes.description: The physical drapery folds on each figure that carry highlight-to-shadow tonal structure, making each figure a miniature tonal system.
evidence: Fabric folds carry the composition's tonal structure; each figure's drapery contains the full value range
Described as decorative appearance with load-bearing function

nodes.label: Discrete figure scale bands: 200cm, 160cm, 80cm
nodes.description: Three stepped figure size registers corresponding to foreground, middle ground, and background depth planes, replacing gradual naturalistic diminution.
evidence: Foreground figures roughly 200cm, middle ground 160cm, background 80cm depicted height
Explicitly not naturalistic scale recession but a stepped hierarchy of three discrete bands
Stage 5: scalar bands prevent the gradual diminution that would expose the exaggeration
rules: Depth registers use discrete size jumps rather than gradual diminution

nodes.label: Void corridors between figure clusters
nodes.description: Negative space channels separating the seven figure clusters, including the central corridor roughly 2.5 meters wide running unobstructed from foreground steps to background sky.
evidence: Seven clusters, four left and three right, separated by negative space corridors
Largest void is the central corridor running unobstructed to the vanishing point
Stage 2 calls voids verification infrastructure allowing continuous confirmation that orthogonals stay synchronized
rules: Corridors must preserve unobstructed sightlines to the vanishing point

nodes.label: Foreground platform of three steps parallel to picture plane
nodes.description: The three steps at the composition's base, oriented parallel to the picture plane with no perspectival recession, forming a threshold between viewer space and depicted space.
evidence: Steps are parallel to the picture plane, establishing a boundary condition prior to the perspectival system
Step figures occupy a liminal zone neither fully in viewer space nor fully in perspectival space
Stage 3: the platform remains structurally active but functionally uninhabited
rules: Platform remains parallel to picture plane with no perspectival recession
rule_violations: A threshold zone should be occupied to enact the spatial transition it defines

nodes.label: Asymmetric figure distribution: 23 left, 29 right
nodes.description: Deliberate violation of the architectural bilateral symmetry through unequal figure counts, preventing the composition from collapsing into static heraldry.
evidence: Left side 23 figures, right side 29 figures against a perfectly symmetric architectural frame
Stage 4 notes the imbalance prevents heraldic stasis but classifies the specific ratio as incidental and arbitrary

nodes.label: Pigment layering economy: 1-2 background layers vs 3-4 foreground layers
nodes.description: Thinner pigment application on background figures lets intonaco white optically mix with pigment, reducing background tonal range to roughly 40 percent versus 80 percent in the foreground.
evidence: Foreground figures use 3 to 4 pigment layers, background 1 to 2, allowing plaster white to mix optically
Produces contrast reduction of roughly 40 percent through material economy rather than color mixing alone
Stage 4 classifies as supporting: reinforces recession but is redundant with perspectival and scalar mechanisms

nodes.label: Giornata seams terminating at figure contours
nodes.description: Daily plaster section boundaries in the fresco buono technique, planned so that no seam bisects a face or limb, preserving each figure as an intact form.
evidence: Seams visible under raking light at figure boundaries, indicating sections planned to end at contour edges
No seam bisects a face or limb, producing structural integrity of forms
rules: Seams terminate at figure contour boundaries, never mid-form

nodes.label: Directional gestures of Plato, Aristotle, and foreground figures
nodes.description: Plato's vertical gesture, Aristotle's horizontal gesture, Pythagoras writing downward, Euclid's circular compass work, and Heraclitus static: vectors that pace eye movement through the composition.
evidence: Gestures establish a pacing pattern of vertical, horizontal, downward, circular, static that guides eye movement
Stage 3: Plato's gesture sends the eye upward outside the perspectival system; Aristotle's disperses attention laterally, redirecting focus away from the vanishing point
rule_violations: Focal figures should sustain attention at the convergence the perspectival system builds toward

edges.rationale: The perspectival system is defined by the convergence of all orthogonals at the single point positioned at Plato's hand; without that point there is no unified recession.
Floor tile recession supplies the base spatial gradient and the primary visible orthogonals on which the single-point system operates.
The amplifier is constituted by the three concrete arches whose serial 100/80/65 percent width reduction produces the multiplied depth cue.

Perspectival amplification requires serial architectural reduction to multiply depth perception beyond baseline geometric recession; the frames mechanically multiply the gradient the perspective establishes, and the perspective survives their removal in weakened form.
Discrete scalar bands of 200, 160, and 80 cm prevent the gradual diminution that would expose the exaggeration of spatial compression, protecting the amplified depth from viewer recalibration.

Stepped size bands exaggerate the depth gradient beyond optical accuracy, strengthening the recession the perspectival system generates; Stage 4 notes they could be replaced by gradual diminution, so this is amplification not requirement.

Void corridors between figure clusters must preserve unobstructed sightlines to the vanishing point to maintain perspectival legibility; they function as verification infrastructure letting the viewer confirm all orthogonals remain synchronized.

Asymmetric figure distribution of 23 left and 29 right requires modular tonal autonomy to prevent compositional destabilization; only because each figure carries its own tonal system can the imbalance affect density without breaking balance.
The distributed tonal system is materially carried by fabric folds containing the full value range per figure; without the drapery there is no local tonal completeness.

Atmospheric perspective through layering economy reduces background tonal range to roughly 40 percent, reinforcing spatial recession; Stage 4 deems it redundant with perspectival and scalar mechanisms, so supporting rather than necessary.

Layering economy reduces background tonal range while maintaining internal tonal completeness within each distant figure, extending modular tonal autonomy across depth in parallel with the drapery system.

Giornata seams terminating at figure contour boundaries prevent structural bisection of forms, preserving each figure as an intact unit and reinforcing the modularity that the tonal system establishes.

The foreground platform parallel to the picture plane establishes the spatial threshold that all subsequent depth planes must negotiate; the tiered registers are organized against this entry condition, and its removal collapses the stepped hierarchy into continuous recession.

The threshold prevents the perspectival system from extending to the picture plane edge, structuring stratification between viewer space and depicted space; the perspective would still function without it but the spatial hierarchy would collapse.

The perspectival system concentrates attention at the vanishing point between Plato and Aristotle, but Plato's vertical and Aristotle's horizontal gestures immediately redirect attention away, so the focal figures refuse the focus the mechanism builds.

violated: Focal figures should sustain attention at the convergence the perspectival system builds toward

failure_modes.consequence: The perspectival infrastructure works perfectly to establish a focal hierarchy at the vanishing point, but the elevated figures redirect attention upward and laterally, undermining the focal convergence and leaving the compositional apex asserted but unoccupied by attention.

violated: Compositional necessity requires at least some structurally indispensable figures

failure_modes.consequence: Modular tonal autonomy enables asymmetric distribution without collapse but prevents structural necessity: because any figure can be subtracted without tonal failure, the 52-figure arrangement is arbitrary rather than inevitable; the work could function with 40 or 60 figures.

violated: A threshold zone should be occupied to enact the spatial transition it defines

failure_modes.consequence: The foreground platform establishes the critical threshold between viewer space and perspectival space, yet no figure occupies it; the step figures have already crossed into perspectival space, leaving a void where the most critical spatial transition should occur.

Without discrete scalar bands, gradual diminution lets the viewer calibrate depicted depth against optical baseline; the serial architectural frames then produce a depth illusion visibly disproportionate to the actual perspectival angle, exposing the exaggeration.

Spatial coherence collapses entirely; the work becomes a collection of figures without unified spatial logic, since the frames, bands, and voids all amplify or certify a recession that no longer exists.

Perspectival depth becomes weak and ambiguous; floor recession alone is insufficient to organize 52 figures across more than 40 meters of depicted space, though the baseline single-point geometry survives.

Compositional modularity fails; the asymmetric distribution of 23 versus 29 figures destabilizes the composition without local tonal autonomy, since no alternative tonal infrastructure carries the balance.

The perspectival system extends to the picture plane edge, collapsing the spatial hierarchy into continuous recession; the threshold between viewer space and depicted space disappears and the tiered stratification loses its entry condition.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, spatial coherence collapses entirely and the work becomes a collection of figures without unified spatial logic.
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, perspectival depth becomes weak and ambiguous, with floor recession alone insufficient to organize 52 figures across depicted 40+ meters.
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed, compositional modularity fails and asymmetric distribution (23 vs 29 figures) destabilizes without local tonal autonomy.
